models_evaluated: BERT-based question and find (Q&F) NLP pipeline

links.outcome: Error counts of NLP output versus manual chart review as reference
links.effect: NLP had fewer errors than manual chart reviews: 12 vs. 22 (P = 0.084), 47 vs. 98 (P = 0.000021), and 31 vs. 53 (P = 0.015).
links.quote: Compared to manual chart reviews, the NLP system demonstrated superior accuracy and fewer errors: 12 vs. 22 (P = 0.084), 47 vs. 98 (P = 0.000021), and 31 vs. 53 (P = 0.015).

unlisted_practices: Using NLP to flag incidental aortic aneurysms in radiology reports and coordinate patient follow-up appointments as a safety net
Comparing NLP extraction accuracy against manual chart review

screen.reason: Evaluates a BERT-based NLP surveillance pipeline implemented to identify incidental aortic aneurysms from radiology reports and coordinate real-world follow-up, but does not compare outcomes with/without a specific deployment safeguard practice.
